about: Atlas preset places (draft 1, for review). Chosen for what makes each place different, not for size. Coordinates: decimal degrees, latitude north, longitude east. Elevation in metres, approximate (it moves sunrise by seconds). tz: IANA zone; for dates before a zone's records it falls back to local mean time. Every place is computable in 2026; the calendar refuses latitudes beyond about 65.6 degrees (2026, sea level), and the limit moves with the era: Oulu is refused around 7500 BCE.

places.name: Quito
places.note: On the equator, high in the Andes: the Sun passes overhead at both equinoxes.

places.name: Singapore
places.note: Just north of the equator; its clock runs over an hour ahead of the Sun.

places.name: Nairobi
places.note: Near the equator in East Africa: the portals span their narrowest.

places.name: Kiritimati
places.note: UTC+14: the first place on Earth to begin each calendar day.

places.name: Honolulu
places.note: Inside the tropic: in June the Sun passes north of the zenith and its line turns back.

places.name: Syene (Aswan)

places.name: Ujjain
places.note: The prime meridian of Indian astronomy, near the Tropic of Cancer.

places.name: Rio de Janeiro

places.name: Alice Springs

places.name: Reykjavík

places.name: Nuuk

places.name: Fairbanks

places.name: Oulu
places.note: On the edge: computable today, refused in eras of greater axial tilt (around 7500 BCE).

places.name: Yakutsk
places.note: The coldest city: long winter nights, near-polar portals.

places.name: Ushuaia
places.note: The southernmost city: the portals reversed and wide.

places.name: Hobart

places.name: Jerusalem

places.name: Qumran

places.name: Mount Hermon

places.name: Dan

places.name: Mount Sinai

places.name: Aksum

places.name: Lalibela

places.name: Bethlehem
places.note: The nativity.

places.name: Jericho
places.note: The lowest city on Earth, among the oldest.

places.name: Mount Ararat
places.note: The ark's resting place; 1 Enoch carries fragments of a Book of Noah.

places.name: Ur
places.note: Ur of the Chaldees: the Moon-god's city.

places.name: Babylon
places.note: Where the astronomical diaries were kept for seven centuries.

places.name: Nineveh
places.note: Ashurbanipal's library: MUL.APIN and the 360-day ideal year.

places.name: Damascus

places.name: Petra

places.name: Alexandria
places.note: The Septuagint, Ptolemy and the Library.

places.name: Mecca

places.name: Rome

places.name: Athens
places.note: Meton's solstice observation, 432 BCE.

places.name: Constantinople (Istanbul)

places.name: Giza

places.name: Karnak (Thebes)

places.name: Abu Simbel
places.note: Twice a year the rising Sun reaches the inner sanctuary.

places.name: Nabta Playa

places.name: Göbekli Tepe

places.name: Persepolis

places.name: Samarkand

places.name: Jaipur

places.name: Bodh Gaya

places.name: Kashgar

places.name: Lhasa
places.note: The roof of the world.

places.name: Angkor Wat
places.note: At the equinox the Sun rises over the central tower.

places.name: Stonehenge
places.note: Midsummer sunrise, midwinter sunset.

places.name: Newgrange

places.name: Callanish

places.name: Uraniborg (Hven)

places.name: Chichén Itzá

places.name: Chaco Canyon

places.name: Rapa Nui

places.name: Uluru

places.name: Mauna Kea

places.name: Paranal

places.name: San Francisco

places.name: New York

places.name: Anchorage

places.name: Mexico City

places.name: Bogotá

places.name: La Paz

places.name: Kathmandu

places.name: Bangkok
